reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, wide-packet re-review batch 7, 2026-08-01

samples_reviewed.question_text: Write the symbol for the seventeenth position.
Write the symbol for the sixteenth position.
Write the symbol for the nineteenth position.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency asks to 'describe the position of objects' but no sample across all 6 seeds names an actual object; seed 50's 'Write the symbol for the nineteenth position.' asks about an abstract position number with no book, child, or item described as occupying it.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Only two translation directions appear across the widened 6 seeds (symbol-to-word at 42/43/46, word-to-symbol at 44/45/50); locating an object at a named position, or naming an object's position in an ordered set, never appears.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The ordinal vocabulary sampled, including the newly added 'nineteenth' at seed 50, is squarely within grade 3 quarter 1 demand, and every stem is a single short clause.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Even with the added cloze-format seed 50, the item bank shows only the two translation directions, with no ordered-list context, no directional framing, and no real-world ordinal scenario anywhere in this widened sample.

competency_alignment.rationale: All 6 seeds, including the new seed 50's 'nineteenth', sit within the 13th-to-19th band, so no progression exists toward the decade forms (twentieth, thirtieth) or compound forms (forty-third, ninety-ninth) that a 100th-ceiling competency should build toward.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The stated ceiling is the 100th position, yet across all 6 samples including the newly sampled cloze seed, the highest keyed position is 19th (seed 50) -- nothing near 50th or 100th is ever exercised.
